decisions.reason: A vertigo combination tablet launched only in 2024 with its own product page has had too little time to be judged against aspirations, and its sunk regulatory investment favours keeping it while results are still uncertain.
A generic antidepressant capsule fits a German generics portfolio, and its first year gives no shortfall signal strong enough to trigger problemistic search, so management will carry it.
A combination antihypertensive is a high-volume chronic therapy with steady demand, and its prominent presentation suggests it is meeting the firm's expectations.

The dietary supplement is only mentioned on the website, which suggests lower commitment and a weaker fit with the core pharmaceutical business, but it costs little to maintain and slack lets the firm wait for more results before dropping it.
